_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score is coiled with no joint ETF-flow + momentum impulse; base rate favors HOLD until a named breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial split — analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative silent on forward phase and only supplies flow color; no shared directional call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays range-bound, 30d momentum near 50, fear_greed 47-62, net venue flows non-impulsive
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows and momentum rise together, or fear_greed <40 with negative funding and rising exchange inflows
